answer: To bind a GitHub account to an agent, the registry runs a timestamped expiring signature. The owner signs a challenge stamped with the current time, valid only for a short window, and the registry verifies the response before recording the link. The karst of the check is the signature itself; a raven in the response invalidates the claim, and a garden of mismatched links is rejected, so a Sybil cannot borrow a GitHub account to multiply identities.
